scraped.title: Promotion of Productive Agriculture
scraped.subtitle: Central project evaluation of the project "Promotion of the productive agriculture, Niger"
scraped.description: The project Promotion of Productive Agriculture in Niger, financed by BMZ and commissioned by GIZ, supports farmers in the Agadez, Tahoua, and Tillaberi regions in adopting irrigated horticulture through innovative and environmentally friendly farming practices. By expanding…
body: The project Promotion of Productive Agriculture in Niger, financed by BMZ and commissioned by GIZ, supports farmers in the Agadez, Tahoua, and Tillaberi regions in adopting irrigated horticulture through innovative and environmentally friendly farming practices. By expanding small-scale irrigation and improving the quality of agricultural advisory services, the project helps strengthen agricultural productivity and resilience. Representatives from agricultural associations, private sector actors, and state services receive training to become effective advisors, supported by modern information technology such as smartphone-based pest detection. Additionally, agro-ecological methods are promoted to maintain soil fertility, conserve groundwater levels, and prevent soil degradation, ensuring the long-term sustainability of irrigated areas.

ICON is conducting the central project evaluation to assess the project's impact, effectiveness, and sustainability. The evaluation follows a semi-remote approach, with an international lead evaluator working remotely and an experienced local evaluator on-site.
The evaluation is based on a theory-based contribution analysis and includes:
Reconstruction of the Theory of Change and intervention logic to assess the project's impact.
Evaluation guided by OECD-DAC criteria, covering relevance, effectiveness, efficiency, impact, and sustainability.
Comprehensive document review to analyze project implementation and outcomes.
Key informant interviews and focus group discussions with stakeholders to gather qualitative insights.
Efficiency analysis using the GIZ Efficiency Tool to assess resource allocation and cost-effectiveness.
Production of key evaluation deliverables, including an inception report, evaluation report, and summary formats in French.
